description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AccountingRuleDuplicateException' used in the accounting rule domain of the Fineract project. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors for different duplicate error scenarios.

classes.name: AccountingRuleDuplicateException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass used specifically to indicate duplicate accounting rules within the domain.

methods.name: AccountingRuleDuplicateException(String name)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a specific accounting rule name, indicating a duplicate exists.

methods.name: AccountingRuleDuplicateException()
methods.description: Constructs the exception indicating that the accounting rule already has the specified tags, representing a duplication.
